name: Agent Factory Delivery Workflow
description: Coordinate the governed design, construction, evaluation, deployment planning, monitoring, and packaging of a custom AI agent without granting unverified authority or overstating readiness.
trigger: An authorized sponsor requests a custom AI agent with defined users, business outcome, operating boundaries, and accountable ownership.

stages.name: Authorize and classify
stages.action: Confirm mission, users, owner, data, decisions, prohibited actions, deployment target, risk, and success measures.

stages.name: Design agent architecture
stages.action: Use AA-SKL-000011 and select single-agent or multi-agent design only when justified.

stages.name: Build instructions and knowledge
stages.action: Use AA-SKL-000012 and AA-SKL-000013 with source, freshness, access, citation, and conflict rules.

stages.name: Design workflows, memory, and tools
stages.action: Use AA-SKL-000014, AA-SKL-000019, and AA-SKL-000020; define authority, schemas, side effects, retention, approvals, reconciliation, and recovery.

stages.name: Evaluate behavior
stages.action: Use AA-SKL-000015 with normal, missing-information, conflict, unsafe, privacy, tool-failure, recovery, and adversarial cases.

stages.name: Plan controlled deployment
stages.action: Use AA-SKL-000016; define environments, access, rollout, monitoring, incident response, rollback, and human approval.

stages.name: Define monitoring and optimization
stages.action: Use AA-SKL-000017; establish quality, safety, cost, latency, adoption, drift, incident, and change-control measures.

stages.name: Package authorized release
stages.action: Use AA-SKL-000021 only when evaluation, rights, documentation, support, and publication authority are complete.

completion_criteria: Mission and prohibited actions are explicit
Knowledge, memory, tools, and workflows have authority and recovery rules
Evaluation evidence covers critical behavior and failures
Deployment and monitoring plans are approved for the target environment

failure_policy.escalation: Stop the affected capability, preserve the last validated configuration and evidence, reconcile uncertain external effects, and escalate authority, safety, privacy, security, legal, or unresolved quality failures to the accountable owner.
